android.desc:
Maximize your time away with smart vacation planning.

Vacation Maximizer helps you get more vacation days by strategically combining your paid time off with weekends and public holidays. Stop wasting precious PTO days – let our smart planner show you when to take time off for the longest possible breaks.

• KEY FEATURES •

• Smart Planning: Automatically finds the best dates to maximize your vacation time
• Public Holidays: Integrated holiday calendars for 100+ countries
• Visual Calendar: See your planned vacations and available days at a glance
• PTO Tracking: Keep track of your remaining vacation days
• Flexible Work Schedule: Customize which days you work
• Multiple Languages: Fully localized in 16 languages
• Privacy First: All your data stays on your device

• HOW IT WORKS •

1. Set your annual PTO days
2. Select your country for automatic public holiday integration
3. Choose your work schedule
4. Let the app suggest optimal vacation periods
5. Plan longer getaways using fewer vacation days

• PERFECT FOR •

• Remote workers planning extended trips
• Families maximizing school holiday overlap
• Anyone who wants to travel more efficiently
• People with limited vacation days
• Digital nomads and frequent travelers

• SUPPORTED COUNTRIES •

Public holidays for 100+ countries including USA, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Australia, Japan, South Africa, and many more.

• LANGUAGES •

English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Swedish, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Hindi, Turkish, Afrikaans

Download Vacation Maximizer today and start planning smarter vacations!

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built a small app called Vacation Maximizer to solve a recurring problem: manually cross-referencing my calendar with public holidays to figure out how to get the longest breaks using the least amount of annual leave.

It’s a simple tool that maps out your PTO for you. It currently supports holiday calendars for over 100 countries.

Key features:

Privacy-first: No account required, no tracking, and it works entirely offline.

Global support: 100+ country calendars included.

Free: I built this as a side project and wanted to keep it accessible for everyone.

Tech/Links:

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/vacation-maximizer/id675843810

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.julietdupreez.vacationmaximizer

More info: https://www.julietdupreez.com/home/vacation-maximizer/

I’d love to hear your feedback on the UI or any additional features (like specific regional holidays) you’d find useful!
